products.title: Wilson Endure Pro V1 2026 - Momo González - Wilson
products.description:
WILSON ENDURE PRO V1 2026 - MOMO GONZÁLEZ - A new era is about to begin with this jewel from Wilson Padel. Momo González's shovel. Intended for players who want the best control in their game. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL 

We present to you the most special Wilson Padel racket of the entire season, the WILSON ENDURE PRO V1 2026 - MOMO GONZÁLEZ model, a racket with total maneuverability. It is Momo González's own model. If you are a fan of the round shape, this is yours. Its format will help us a lot to achieve a safe game from any area of ​​the court.

PLAYER TYPE

This racket is intended for players who want control over the ball, although it gives us a lot of power, thanks to its materials, it is a racket with 100% control, with a perfect round format and an ideal low balance.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The new WILSON ENDURE PRO V1 2026 - MOMO GONZÁLEZ has materials that make it special. Deep work has been done on it to offer a completely new racket, with unique materials. On the planes, it incorporates unidirectional 3K carbon fiber. This new carbon treatment offers extra flexibility and much more resistance.

The interior incorporates dual-density foam called Control Foam, which improves the connection with the ball. This type of material offers incredible control over the ball.

One of the technologies it offers us is its double and reinforced Y-BEAM bridge, which helps us achieve better balance and reduce vibrations. It is a great padel racket to reduce arm discomfort.

products.description:
WILSON OPTIX V2 LITE LILAC - Do you want extra lightness? The new Optix Lite offers you a lower weight. Round in format, it guarantees high control. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The WILSON OPTIX V2 LITE LILAC 2026 is the most economical Wilson racket in the 2026 collection. It is a LITE version, lighter and more manageable for a player who is starting out and looking for greater security and comfort. It is a padel racket with a round format and an extensive sweet spot.

PLAYER TYPE

This type of racket is recommended for an intermediate player who plays occasionally and is looking for a light racket with total maneuverability. The Balance of this racket is low and it will help us above all to move it from the bottom. Allows you to react faster.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

This WILSON OPTIX V2 LITE LILAC 2026 is a racket manufactured with a weight of 355 grams and low balance. At the same time, it has a 100% fiberglass composition, both the frame and the planes incorporate this material. It offers greater flexibility than carbon, increasing ball output but reducing hardness.

The core is made of Foam, a low-density foam, with a soft touch, to improve control and ball output as soon as the ball comes into contact with the racket.

products.title: Head Revolt Pro 5.0 Men Blueberry Teal - Head
products.description:

Diseñadas para que duren mucho tiempo. Las HEAD REVOLT PRO 5.0 MEN BLUEBERRY TEAL representan una evolución clara dentro de la gama de alto rendimiento. Están diseñadas para jugadores de alto rendimiento ya que por sus características y prestaciones, son la mejor opción para sacarle partido al 100%.

Estabilidad estructural avanzada
Incorporan tres piezas moldeadas en 3D de TPU estratégicamente situadas en la mediasuela y la parte superior. Destaca tecnología CORE-CONTROL, un chasis de TPU que estabiliza el pie desde la zona media hasta la parte lateral delantera.

Además, este modelo integra un novedoso sistema de refrigeración, el cual nos mejora y mucho tanto la ventilación como la estabilidad.

Amortiguación inteligente en triple EVA
La mediasuela combina tres compuestos para optimizar rendimiento y confort:

DynaFoam en el talón: excelente absorción de impactos.

EVA reactiva en el antepié: mayor impulso y respuesta.

Zona más blanda en el mediopié y dedo gordo: confort adicional en apoyos prolongados.
